signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your work email and password.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Sign up with your work email to join or start an organization.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.description: Open the link we sent to confirm your email address.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

twoFactorSetup.title: Set up two-step verification
twoFactorSetup.description: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Your new password replaces the old one on every device.

acceptInvitation.title: Join your organization
acceptInvitation.description: Accept the invitation to start working with your team.

chooseOrganization.title: Choose an organization
chooseOrganization.description: Pick the organization you want to work in.

noOrganization.title: You're not in an organization yet
noOrganization.description: Ask an admin of your organization to invite you.
